title: Secure Cloud Operator - Lesson 8: Understanding IAM Roles
objectives: Understand the concept of IAM roles in AWS
Learn how to list and describe IAM roles using the AWS CLI

mission_brief.situation: As a cloud security operator, you need to ensure that your IAM roles are properly configured to manage access to your resources.
mission_brief.mission: List and describe all IAM roles in your AWS account
mission_brief.execution: Use the AWS CLI to list and describe IAM roles

content.concept: IAM roles are used to manage access to resources in your AWS account. They can be attached to users, groups, or services.
content.walkthrough: The AWS CLI provides commands to list and describe IAM roles. You will use the `aws iam list-roles` command to list all IAM roles in your account.
checkpoints: Understand how IAM roles are used in your AWS account
Use the AWS CLI to list and describe IAM roles
common_mistakes: Not properly configuring IAM roles, leading to security vulnerabilities

bug_injection.fix: Reconfigure IAM roles to restrict access

pass_conditions: Access is restricted to authorized users
fail_conditions: IAM roles are not properly configured

interrogation_questions: What is the purpose of IAM roles in AWS?
How do you list and describe IAM roles using the AWS CLI?

allowed: List and describe IAM roles using the AWS CLI

resume_bullets: Listed and described all IAM roles in the AWS account
Understood how to properly configure IAM roles for secure access
